description: Register your own domain so form notification email can come from it (e.g. forms@yourdomain.com) instead of Novence's address. Pro/Scale. Returns DNS records (DKIM, SPF) to add at the domain's DNS host; then call verify_sending_domain. Idempotent for a domain you already added.

domain.description: Domain you control, e.g. acmebakery.com or mail.acmebakery.com.

name: add_sending_domain
title: Add sending domain
